constraints: Prefer --json for scripts, CI, and other machine-safe automation flows.
Treat status: error as a non-zero automation failure condition.
Persist status and run summaries in .outcomegraph/work/, .outcomegraph/events/, .outcomegraph/claims/, and .outcomegraph/certificates/.
Do not conclude success unless outputs include explicit parseable status data and deterministic runtime, status, and message fields.
For daemon sync paths, malformed or non-JSON og sync --json output must be treated as failure.
Keep edits minimal and production-safe, preserve existing ok/warn/error conventions, and avoid speculative refactors.
goal: Capture the repository-documented og operational contract so another agent can reconstruct OutcomeGraph command selection, safety checks, and anchor paths from repository evidence.

oracles.name: Documentation oracle from skills/og/SKILL.md for og command selection, pipeline ordering, safety checks, and anchor paths
Entrypoint and runtime-path oracle from og and og.py; the payload corroborates wrapper and path constants but does not include executed verification commands
Filesystem topology oracle from .outcomegraph snapshots; directory listings confirm persisted state locations but not live CLI behavior
